Doctor of Credit says both cards earn reward fee waivers through spending ($15,000 / $25,000); the exact thresholds per card were not confirmed.
The Signature ($99) is treated as the standard tier; the Infinite ($499) is the premium tier. The user's tier is not known.

watch.notes: Plain GET works (200; redirects to https://www.cardless.com/cards/qatar/compare, a Framer-built page). Fees, welcome offers and Qpoints ratios are in the HTML; per-category Avios multipliers are NOT (only meta description 'Earn up to 5x Avios'), so earn-rate changes cannot be detected from this page. Companion PDFs fetch fine: https://legal.cardless.com/schumer/premium-99-qatar/rates_and_fees.pdf (200, 110,510 bytes) and .../premium-499-qatar/rates_and_fees.pdf (200, 107,770 bytes); byte length is usable as a change signal.

cards.name: Wells Fargo Autograph Visa

earn.label: 3X on restaurants
earn.notes: Eating places, restaurants, fast food, caterers and drinking places. Bakeries, grocery stores and third-party delivery services are excluded. No cap.

earn.label: 3X on travel
earn.notes: Airlines, hotels and motels, campgrounds, timeshares, cruise lines, travel agencies, discount travel sites and vehicle rentals. No cap.

earn.label: 3X on gas stations
earn.notes: Gas stations and automated fuel dispensers. Auto repair, car washes, superstores, warehouse clubs and grocery stores excluded.

earn.label: 3X on EV charging stations
earn.notes: Part of Wells Fargo's 'Gas (Fuel/Charging)' category.

earn.label: 3X on transit
earn.notes: Ferries, parking lots and garages, limousines, taxis, passenger railways, toll bridges and highways. Rideshare apps are not named; whether they code as taxi/limousine is unconfirmed.

earn.label: 3X on popular streaming services
earn.notes: Services considered cable or pay television; bundled or third-party-billed streaming may not qualify. Eligible list at wellsfargo.com/autographstreaming.

earn.label: 3X on phone plans
earn.notes: Landline and cell phone providers; add-on services, phones and accessories, and bundled/third-party-billed plans may not qualify.

other_benefits: Cell phone protection up to $600 against damage or theft, $25 deductible, two paid claims per 12 months; phone bill must be paid with the card
No foreign transaction fee; points do not expire while the account is open

Product-change history: the Wells Fargo Bilt Mastercard stopped taking new applicants 2025-11-05 and existing accounts converted to the Autograph Visa (new card number) on 2026-02-07; Bilt Rewards and rent earning no longer apply to this card; points do not carry a welcome bonus on conversion
open_questions: Wells Fargo's Bilt-conversion FAQ page only returned a redirect notice; the conversion date (2026-02-07) and 'Autograph Visa with a new card number' come from third-party coverage and the search-result snippet of that FAQ. Earn terms assume the converted card has the standard Autograph terms (Autograph terms effective 2025-12-30).
Rideshare (Uber/Lyft) is not named in Wells Fargo's transit definition; not recorded as earning 3X.
Point value: Wells Fargo shows 20,000 points = $200 cash, i.e. 1 cent each for cash; transfer-partner value is 1 point = 1 partner mile/point.

The terms summary https://www.wellsfargo.com/credit-cards/autograph-visa/terms/ also works (redirects to .../documents/autograph-visa-terms/, 81,568 bytes, identical on repeat) and is the more stable target for category definitions.
